title: Bass players Breaux admired: Albert Morgan, Blanton, Kid Twat, Chester, Cleo
summary: Breaux names the New Orleans and other bassists he liked when young, from Albert Morgan and Jimmy Blanton to Kid Twat, Chester and Cleo.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how

I didn't know Chester during that time.

Chester was splendid. Chester Zotus. Chester Zotus. He played a real nice bass. He and Cleo. Remember Cleo? Yeah, Cleo. Cleo got killed. Simon was on that time. I don't remember hearing him. Simon Morales? I heard of him. And Mr. Glenn, I always respect him. He was playing. Melis Raleigh? I don't remember hearing him. There was another youngster, Harmon Mitchell's, I don't know if you remember him or not. He's in California too now. He and I started music at the same time. Yeah, I knew what I remember. He used to play the violin too. Yeah, I knew what I remember. And the concert band over at the school, he played the melophon. He played a nice melophon. I mean, he tried to be a wonderful little bass player. I used to love to hear him play. And Gishaw is too. Young Gishaw, he's a fine bass player.
